description: Active profit-locking rules. Applied to ALL open positions via the Position Monitor loop. Never give back a profit to become a loss.
lesson: Gold was +$1,494 unrealized, gave back $1,588 to end at -$293. With these rules, minimum +$500 locked.

tight_stop_rule.description: With v6.0 sizing (25+ units), wide stops = huge losses. Stop distance must be proportional to position size.
tight_stop_rule.rule: Max stop distance = Risk Budget ÷ Units. For $500 risk on 25 units = $20 max stop. NOT $40.
tight_stop_rule.lesson: Gold 25 units with $40 stop = $1,000 max loss. Should have been $20 stop = $500 max loss or $10 stop with smaller target.

recommended_stops.swing_small: $15-20 stop — for 4H-Daily holds with proper sizing
recommended_stops.swing_wide: $30-40 stop — ONLY with reduced units (5-10 not 25)

tier_1_breakeven.action: Move SL to entry price (breakeven). Can no longer lose on this trade.
tier_1_breakeven.how: Modify the stop loss order on TradingView to entry price.

tier_2_lock_50.action: Move SL to lock in $50 profit (entry + $50/units = new SL).
tier_2_lock_50.how: Modify stop loss to entry + ($50 ÷ units).

tier_3_lock_100.action: Move SL to lock in $100 profit.
tier_3_lock_100.how: Modify stop loss to entry + ($100 ÷ units).

tier_4_sell_half.action: Sell HALF the position at market. Move SL to lock $250 on remaining half.
tier_4_sell_half.how: Close half position, modify SL on rest.

tier_5_lock_500.action: Move SL to lock in $500 on remaining position.

tier_6_trail.action: Trail SL by 1x ATR(14) on the entry timeframe. Lock in progressively more.
tier_6_trail.how: Recalculate SL each check based on current price minus ATR.

position_monitor.description: Separate from market scanner. Uses TradingView MCP quotes (free, unlimited). Does NOT use Twelve Data credits.
position_monitor.data_source: TradingView MCP quote_get — switch chart to each position, get quote

frequency.in_loss: Every 15 minutes — SL handles the exit
frequency.near_sl_or_tp: Every 2 minutes — within 1% of SL or TP

actions_per_check: Get current price for each open position
Check if any profit-lock tier triggered
If triggered: modify SL on TradingView immediately
If tier 4 triggered: sell half position
Log all SL modifications to journal.json

critical_rule: Once a SL is moved UP to lock profit, it NEVER moves back down. Profit locks are one-way only.
